settings.heading: More than a paw
settings.text: A gift they'll keep forever: for new pets, birthdays, adoption anniversaries and remembrance. Everything you need is in one box, no oven required.

settings.question: Does it work for cats and dogs?
settings.answer: Yes. The soft clay picks up paw and nose details for dogs and cats.
